title: Choose words for their meaning
rule: Choose wording for meaning, not for a stock phrase checklist.
example: Keep “robust” when it describes resistance to outliers and the analysis supports it.
counterexample: Remove “robust” solely because it appears on a list of AI words.
rationale: A phrase list does not determine whether wording serves the reader.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/fac/_template/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
